description: Republish a published or partial post as a NEW post, live now, to the same accounts. Returns post_id and tracking_id for get_publish_status. To retry only the failed accounts on an existing post use publish_post instead.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

post_id.description: Published or partial post to repost

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

name: post_again
